title: Vibe.94 - A$$ (Throw It Up)
htmlContent:
Vibe.94 - A$$ (Throw It Up) is a refreshing display of music for the world to enjoy.  This is a melodic track bringing sultry sounds to the urban club scene with Vibe94s seductive crooning within the songs hook, while StunnaC4 & UnderGod Gwalla's verses bring the fellas out to flex the big chains and the nice rides for a night of flirty fun! It all is done at a supreme level, as we get familiar with the next big star in music called Vibe.94. Her unlimited promise and appeal is what helps her shine, as she makes music beyond her years, for music that will be considered classic work.
